slides.title: Wednesday at a glance
slides.body: A packed day across soccer, hoops, and more. Check start times and channels before first whistle.

slides.title: Champions League kicks off
slides.body: Real Madrid, Liverpool, Man City, Arsenal, Napoli, PSV, Dortmund, and more on Paramount+.

slides.title: Late soccer window
slides.body: Best of the 3 PM ET slate: Napoli at Porto, Man City at Leipzig, Arsenal at Slavia Prague.

slides.title: NBA doubleheader
slides.body: 76ers at Pistons on ESPN at 7 PM ET, then Hawks at Wizards on MNMT.

slides.title: College hoops, too
slides.body: NC State hosts Campbell on ACC Network at 6 PM ET, followed by Dartmouth vs Framingham State on ESPN+.
